name: Nagyfüged (Hungary)
description: Three horizontal stripes of blue, white and blue in the ratio 1:6:1, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Nagyfüged (a blue shield with a tree, ears of grain and a wavy stripe) below the name NAGYFÜGED in black.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
